clips.title: The story
paras: On the Echo Isles, Zalazane's treachery has driven the Darkspear from their home. Master Gadrin of Sen'jin Village sends Horde champions to end the witch doctor's rule. Dark magic drove Zalazane mad, and he enslaved his fellow tribesmen, seizing the Darkspear trolls' rightful home and forcing them into exile on Durotar's coast.

The Darkspear made a home on the Echo Isles after fleeing their sunken island and following Thrall across the Great Sea. The isles lie just off Durotar's southeast coast. Zalazane, once a respected and powerful witch doctor of the tribe, hungered for power. He used hexes to enslave the minds of his kin and began a violent uprising. Vol'jin led the Darkspear who remained free, but they were driven from their ancestral camps across the water. They had to build a temporary refuge at Sen'jin Village.

Zalazane still sends raiding parties from his hilltop stronghold on the largest Echo Isle. They cross the channel to seize more Darkspear and drag them under his control. The captured trolls become mindless voodoo and hexed thralls, lost to their tribe. Master Gadrin sees more than an occupation of Darkspear land: Zalazane threatens the tribe's survival. Until his severed head is brought before the elders, no Darkspear can be safe.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The witchdoctor Zalazane dwells on the Echo Isles to the east. They are the isles we once called home.
From there he sends his travelers to the mainland, to hex our people and drag more of them under his sway.
Defeat Zalazane and his minions -- former Darkspear travelers, now lost to us. Bring me his head and I will know his reign of evil is over.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With Zalazane gone, our tribe can again sleep in peace. Thank you, friend. The Darkspear tribe owes you much. If you suffer from an ailment, visit my assistant Bom'bay, behind me. His voodoo is strong...
